metadata.statistical_discipline: Five frozen E checkpoints are the independent units; F is a control. Probes are analysis-only, fit on the regime's train, tuned on its val, evaluated once on the untouched test hard tail.

decision.rule_note: R-D (checked first): held-out-operand gap >= 0.30 -> apparent gains are memorization, not recoverability. R-B: best bounded probe >= 0.50 with material capacity gain and held-out operands preserved. R-A: size-matched distribution shift >= 0.15, >=4/5 seeds, held-out operands preserved. R-C: no capacity gain, no size-matched distribution shift, best < 0.50. Otherwise R-MIX. Bars are declared conventions.
